database.reason: Schema epoch 4 adds 256_desktop_agent_key_purpose.sql: a nullable managed-key purpose and a partial unique index. Legacy keys and billing rows are not rewritten. Desktop bootstrap is disabled until explicitly configured. Older binaries lack the purpose-based managed-key mutation protection; after enabling desktop credentials, do not mix old and new API instances or assume an image-only rollback is safe. Retain the pre-release database backup. Desktop settings now serialize models/default_model_id; historical single-model settings remain readable, but older binaries cannot consume a saved multi-model policy, so restore the matching settings backup when reverting. Epoch 3 gallery compatibility still applies: dsapi_005 accepts original assets below 50 MB without the old 20MP constraint, so recovery across that boundary requires the matching database backup and object-storage recovery planning. Migrations 254/255 retain private ticket attachments and announcement display modes. Official v0.2.21 adds the usage covering index and cache TTL columns. Existing migration filenames and checksums remain unchanged; migrations are tracked by full filename. Desktop capability profiles additionally serialize optional model_profiles metadata; before saving the new format retain the exact desktop_agent_config_v1 setting. Rolling back to a binary without profile metadata requires restoring or explicitly converting that single configuration record; never restore user balances, usage or old Key secrets as part of a configuration-only rollback. Official v0.2.22 adds 251_group_force_openai_ultrafast.sql (disabled by default) and 251_group_usage_rollup_nonblocking_build.sql (additive rollup state columns and replacement invalidation functions); retain the pre-upgrade backup and validate concurrent usage writes with rollup rebuilds before deployment. Official and fork migrations sharing a numeric prefix remain distinct by full filename; previously applied migration names and checksums are preserved. Official v0.2.23 adds 252_channel_pricing_ultrafast_multiplier.sql: a nullable channel_model_pricing.ultrafast_multiplier with a strictly-positive-or-NULL check and no historical row backfill; NULL inherits the model default multiplier at the request pricing time. It remains distinct from the existing fork 252_ticket_read_state.sql by full filename. Preserve all applied migration checksums and retain the pre-upgrade database backup. Workbench migrations dsapi_006 through dsapi_020 add conversation, file, node, and search accounting state. dsapi_013 closes abandoned legacy workbench runs. dsapi_012 permits accountless paid search records that the original production usage reader cannot scan. Keep paid search disabled until a compatible rollback image has been verified against new usage rows. Preserve database and private object versions across rollback.
